title: 座

sentences.imageNotes: 河上有一座橋，主角小女孩在安全的河邊看著橋。畫面要清楚表現河和一座橋；不可有文字、數字、路牌、標籤或注音。
sentences.imagePrompt: Use the approved L058 lesson images only as illustration style references: warm children picture-book watercolor and colored-pencil style, soft natural light, phone-readable square image / 1:1 composition. Do not copy any specific person from L058. Use recurring protagonist family continuity from L154/L162/L163: the protagonist little girl, warm expressive preschool proportions. Scene: a calm river with exactly one clear bridge crossing over it; the protagonist little girl stands safely on the riverbank looking at the bridge. Center the river, bridge, and girl with generous safe margins. No visible text, letters, numbers, road signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, or readable marks.

sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩安全坐在車子的後座，主角爸爸或主角媽媽在前座。畫面要安全、溫和，不要出現行車危險；車內不可有文字、數字、車牌、標籤或注音。

sentences.imageNotes: 晚上，主角小女孩在安全的小橋或觀景橋上看天空星座，旁邊可有主角爸爸陪同。不要畫成車道橋或危險橋面；天空可有星星連成星座圖形，但不可有文字、數字、標籤或注音。
